strings.name: Youssou N’Dour
strings.role: Singer, songwriter and former government minister
strings.summary: Youssou N’Dour connects Senegalese tradition and global pop through Wolof singing and mbalax rhythms. Collaborations with Neneh Cherry and others broadened his audience, while Egypt linked music with Sufi faith. Alongside leading Super Étoile, he entered media and public affairs, served as a minister in 2012–2013 and continued performing.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: He brought Senegalese mbalax to world audiences, increasing African culture’s visibility through international collaboration and public activity.
